heading: Privacy policy
intro: How PROMOTIONAL SOURCING collects, uses and protects the personal data of visitors to promotional-sourcing.eu, in accordance with the GDPR and French data protection law.
seoDescription: How PROMOTIONAL SOURCING collects, uses and protects your personal data, in accordance with the GDPR.

responsable.title: Data controller
responsable.body:
PROMOTIONAL SOURCING, société par actions simplifiée
72 quai de Bacalan, 33300 Bordeaux — France
SIREN 108 093 790 — Bordeaux Trade and Companies Register
Email: contact@promotional-sourcing.eu

Given its size and the nature of its processing activities, PROMOTIONAL SOURCING is not required to appoint a Data Protection Officer. Any question regarding your data can be sent to the address above.

donnees-collectees.title: Data we collect
donnees-collectees.body:
We only collect data that you provide to us voluntarily:

  • Through the contact form: full name, company, type of enquiry (general or partnership), work email address, phone number (optional) and the content of your message.
  • Technical data: connection logs generated automatically by our host (IP address, date and time of request, pages viewed, browser type), for security and site-reliability purposes.

No field goes beyond what is strictly necessary to handle your enquiry. We do not collect any special category data within the meaning of Article 9 of the GDPR.

finalites.title: Purposes and legal bases
finalites.body:
• Responding to your enquiry and managing the business relationship — legal basis: the legitimate interest of PROMOTIONAL SOURCING (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) in responding to a professional enquiry that you initiated yourself.
  • Ensuring the security and availability of the website — legal basis: legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Your data is never sold, rented or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

destinataires.title: Recipients and processors
destinataires.body:
Your data is processed by authorised staff within PROMOTIONAL SOURCING. We use the following processor:

  • Clever Cloud SAS (Nantes, France) — hosting of the website and of the application, including the e-mail delivery of enquiries sent through the contact form. The data is hosted within the European Union: this processing involves no transfer outside the Union.

Your data may also be disclosed to administrative or judicial authorities where required by law.

conservation.title: Retention periods
conservation.body:
• Contact enquiries: 3 years from our last exchange with you, in line with the French data protection authority's (CNIL) recommendation for B2B prospecting.
  • Connection logs: 12 months maximum.

After these periods, your data is deleted or anonymised.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: promotional-sourcing.eu does not set any cookies and uses no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking tools. No prior consent is therefore required simply to browse the site, and no cookie banner is needed.

securite.title: Security
securite.body: The website is served entirely over HTTPS. Access to enquiries received via the form is restricted to authorised staff at PROMOTIONAL SOURCING and protected by authentication.

vos-droits.title: Your rights
vos-droits.body:
Under Articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the following rights over your data:

  • the right of access and to obtain a copy of your data;
  • the right to rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data;
  • the right to erasure (the "right to be forgotten");
  • the right to restriction of processing;
  • the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest;
  • the right to data portability;
  • the right to give instructions on what happens to your data after your death.

To exercise these rights, write to contact@promotional-sourcing.eu or to the postal address given in section 1. We will respond within one month. Proof of identity may be requested if there is reasonable doubt as to your identity.

reclamation.title: Complaints
reclamation.body: If, after contacting us, you believe your rights have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority (CNIL) — 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07 — cnil.fr.

modification.title: Changes to this policy
modification.body: This policy may change, in particular when the platform launches. The date of the latest update appears at the top of this page. See also our legal notice.
